# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper for the college girls at Tabby's Place  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000)</sub>; Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>; Aunty J.  <sub>[v3 c24 P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Euphemia is a small, elderly woman with a gently triangular face, big tender blue eyes, and rose-colored cheeks. Her silver-white hair is arranged in charming small rolls above her ears. She dresses in outmoded garments and worn footwear that she finds comfortable.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia possesses a youthful outlook, a radiant smile, and an indulgent, cheerful nature. She is relaxed with the young women under her care, choosing not to strictly supervise them and accepting their youthful antics with patience and humor. She maintains a respectful deference toward the clergy and holds firmly to her outmoded views and comfortable way of life. While candid about her past grudges, she considers holding ill feelings to be a waste of time as one ages.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064), [v3 c19 P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c35 P17](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0017), [v3 c37 P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

- Maintain a warm, pleasant home at Tabby's Place for the college students  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001)</sub>

## History

Left alone in a large house after her single daughter departed for foreign mission work, Aunt Euphemia was invited to move to Portmaris to manage a rented house named Tabby's Place for college students Nell, Honora, Mabel, and Cressida. She arrived after the young women set up the house, bringing along her cats—the Sarah-cat and Joseph. Over the next three winters, she served as a housemother to the girls, keeping the home warm and welcoming visiting college friends with a cheerful, relaxed attitude. During the Christmas break, she chose to stay behind at Tabby's Place to tend to the house and care for the cats rather than leave them unattended. She frequently shared her practical wisdom and humor, offered advice on suitors and education, and observed the young women complete their college years. When the group prepared to disperse at graduation, Aunt Euphemia decided to adopt Smudge so that he could remain together with her other two cats.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Given the legal name Jamesina because her father James drowned at sea a month before her birth  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in a family of about six girls  <sub>[v3 c19 P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>
- Was widowed after her late husband passed away  <sub>[v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>
- Has a daughter who earned an M.A. degree and became a foreign missionary  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>
- Given the cat Sarah-cat as a gift by her laundress  <sub>[v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)</sub>

## Quotes

> Fresh footwear looks finer than worn footwear, yet the worn footwear feels more pleasant. I have reached an age where I can pamper myself regarding footwear and views.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> Fulfill what you owe to God, to those around you, and to yourself, while enjoying your life. Such is the doctrine I live by, and it has served me quite effectively.  <sub>[v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004)</sub>

> A person can easily catch rheumatism in her legs, Nell. However, solely the elderly ought to experience soul rheumatism. Fortunately, I have escaped it entirely. Once your soul is afflicted with rheumatism, you may as well proceed to select your coffin.  <sub>[v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)</sub>

> The four of you have been the sweetest, dearest, best girls who ever attended college as a group  <sub>[v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)</sub>

> Separating those cats after they have mastered coexisting would be a pity. Cats and people find that a difficult lesson to master.  <sub>[v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008)</sub>
